notes.title: Update v1.2.0
notes.content:
Hey everyone! : ) 
We are back with new exciting content for Burnit Quest!

[b]New Feature:[/b]
Two new exercise styles for endless mode:
[list]
[*][b]Endless Swimming[/b]: Do jumping jacks on a procedurally generated underwater stage
[*][b]Endless Slingshot[/b]: Do as many sit-ups as you want on this slingshot stage
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Wrong collisions in some stages
[*] Flame Dash skill was buggy in some instances
[*] Lots of graphic bug fixes
[*] The Skills button on the lose screen wasn't navigating properly
[/list]

That's it for today! We'll keep putting out new content and improvements, stay tuned and keep on burning!

Gabe[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42066958/362005463ef433a9d98374d4f74209579cc38a03.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42066958/fceba1a03829e4cfa1bbc0499243edfb2179a4be.jpg[/img][/url]

Gabe

notes.title: Update v1.1.2! Multiplayer hotfixes!
notes.content:
Hi,
I'm back with a bunch of new fixes to the VS multiplayer mode! 
Thanks to user Arelyn530 from r/BurnitQuest! 

Here are the fixes this time around:

[list]
[*] Versus Stampede mode is finally accessible! 
[*] Bumpers on Last to Fall Versus won't affect both players at the same time on collision
[*] Versus fishing had a weird bug where the fishing rods would start at a weird location
[*] Some graphical fixes were done too
[/list]

Next up I'll be working in implementing all characters on versus mode! 
Stay tuned and keep on burning!

notes.title: Update v1.1.1
notes.content:
Hey! 
It's been a while folks! We are back with another quick Burnit Quest update:

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players could jump over the end of stage pyres with enough jump skill
[*] Trophy on stage 6-3 wasn't working properly
[*] Graphic fixes in stage 5-4 and 5-5
[*] Adjusted issues with stage tracking on stage 6
[/list]

I currently got a full-time job, but the updates will keep coming, thanks to everyone that has been playing and reporting these improvements!

By the way, check out Burnit Quest's official soundtrack made by our excellent friends from Silverpine Project: https://distrokid.com/hyperfollow/silverpineproject/burnit-quest-original-soundtrack

Gabe

notes.title: Update v1.1.0
notes.content:
Hey! 
We have some exciting news for Burnit Quest check out the list below:

[b]New Feature:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added endless run modes for Forest, Beach, Plateau, Springs, Peaks and Ruins levels, now you can work out on your favorite stage!
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where sometimes damage shown wouldn't correspond with the damage dealt
[*] Made it so game settings are saved in player data
[*] Improved how fast Rith stops when you stop running
[*] A lot of graphic improvements!
[/list]

Now all the fonts in the game are set up for translation, we will also release a demo soon.
That's it for now, take care,

Gabe

notes.title: Patch 1.0,7
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It's time for our first [b]Steam Patch Notes[/b]!

I'll be quick this time, so bear with me:

[h2]New stuff[/h2]
[olist]
[*]New enemy implemented on Alerga Beach:
[b]Usinginzi:[/b]  A burrowing worm that jumps when it gets close to you
[*]Improved animations for magugo (the mage enemy)
[/olist]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Removed a floating bird from the hot springs stage
[*]Fixed a bug where you'd unlock the all skills achievement by purchasing your first skill
[*]A bunch of minor visual bugs
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Improved navigation, now you can access the Skilltree from the game over screen
[*] Changed all raster text for engine native text
[/olist]

I'm currently reworking Rith's visuals based on the game cover! It's looking pretty great! Can't wait to show all of you!
